title: Spicy Turnip and Spanish Sausage Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican-inspired skillet dish featuring turnip and Spanish sausage, cooked to perfection with a hint of light and stir-fry spices.
instructions: Heat the fry (olive oil) in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced turnip and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
Add the light (cumin), Spanish (paprika), and stir (chili powder) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro if desired.
